programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #3
programme.desc: 偷獵危機加劇,偷獵者將注意力轉向孤兒們。四周大的牙美拿失去母親後終於在犀牛孤兒院找到庇護。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加: 大自然的面紗 #1
programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加: 大自然的面紗 #2
programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 哥斯大黎加: 大自然的面紗 #3
programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #1
programme.desc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭。變髒是工作的一部分。當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務。這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人。而且,總能忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #3
programme.desc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物。深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就。還有,努力無堅不摧。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #4
programme.desc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成、新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想。茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然。例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯。來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事。是時候告別韋札的家人。

programme.title: 納萊迪: 小象故事
programme.desc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #1
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 貓頭鷹的秘密生活 #2
programme.desc: 這個令人驚嘆的系列以前所未有的方式揭開《貓頭鷹的秘密生活》,使用特殊的綁定攝影機在春、夏、冬季跟蹤雅息士郡鄉村荒野角落的貓頭鷹家族。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #6
programme.desc: 本集探索大自然中最頑強的動物如何適應地球上一些最惡劣環境中的極端條件。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #7
programme.desc: 我們在本集將探索動物的溝通以及難以置信的適應能力,並揭示動物間能夠「交談」。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #8
programme.desc: 研究大自然動物中的交際花,揭示因同居而演化出的令人驚訝和難以置信的行為。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #9
programme.desc: 展示大自然一些最難以置信的動物頭腦,牠們的大腦顯現出高智慧,使牠們能在競爭中取得優勢。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #10
programme.desc: 我們在本集探討動物為何及如何戰鬥,並揭示牠們天生不惜一切生存下來的方法。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態。從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海。探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #3
programme.desc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統。在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集見證大自然最非凡的動物遷徙,並發現牠們為了生存而必須出走多遠。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #3
programme.desc: 動物嬰兒: 為了嬰兒免受極端情況、飢餓掠食者和飢餓威脅,所有動物都必須為其物種的未來而戰。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #4
programme.desc: 求偶是最強大的本能之一。從美麗的到奇怪的,本集探索動物王國裡最驚奇的交配儀式。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #5
programme.desc: 本集探索世上最毒的動物,揭示毒物和毒液如何讓牠們在生存鬥爭中獲得競爭優勢。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #1
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 下一站: 中國雲南 #2
programme.desc: 《下一站: 中國雲南》將帶領觀眾欣賞雲南一些最美、最壯觀的風景,那是約6,000種植物、200種哺乳類動物和500種鳥類的家。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #1
programme.desc: 在犀牛孤兒院需要耐性與忠誠,因為他們要撫養那些因偷獵而失去母親的年輕犀牛。

programme.title: 犀牛孤兒院 #2
programme.desc: 兩頭最老的犀牛將重返大自然。三頭犀牛的失蹤引起鬨動,而年輕的犀牛則逐漸康復和變得快樂。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #6
programme.desc: 從出生起就充滿了風險和回報。動物為了成年必須不斷克服難以置信的障礙。牠們必須學習覓食、保護家園、吸引配偶、養兒育女,心心念念一件事──生存下去。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #7
programme.desc: 從在樹枝上尋找配偶,到適應高處生活,樹棲動物進化出獨有的特徵,以確保牠們在這惡劣又複雜的環境茁壯成長。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #8
programme.desc: 獵物們利用巧妙的適應力和狡猾的技巧,進化出難以置信的技巧來逃避死亡。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #9
programme.desc: 爬行動物、兩棲動物、昆蟲和魚類遍佈我們世界的每個角落——而對於這一特殊的動物群體而言,牠們的生活是由太陽所主宰的。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #10
programme.desc: 僅僅是有一點點不同,就可能帶來巨大的優勢,但同時也會帶來極大的挑戰。這些動物逆勢而行,找到了獨特的生存之道。

programme.title: 納萊迪: 小象故事
programme.desc: 《納萊迪: 小象故事》講述一隻救助中心小象孤兒的旅程,被委以她生存重任的男人在奮力拯救她生命的同時,也要為保護整個物種而爭分奪秒。

programme.title: 下一站: 緬甸
programme.desc: 《下一站: 緬甸》將帶領觀眾欣賞緬甸一些最美、最壯觀的「亞洲遺產」濕地,那裡有坐著漁夫的單槳舢舨和水上花園。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #1
programme.desc: 本集讲述了这些雄伟的座头鲸的旅程,从觅食地到繁殖地,母鲸与幼鲸之间的温柔时光,以及幼鲸在最初几个月面临的危险,包括与食肉鲸的惊人互动。座头鲸还面临着一个充满人类威胁的世界,从大型集装箱船到寻找石油和天然气时地震测试的影响,现在这些威胁再次威胁到它们的生存。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘鱼通常被称为恐龙鱼,在化石记录中占有独特的地位,近一个世纪前重新发现它时震惊了科学界。我们跟随它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科学家进行探险,以揭开它们更多的秘密和行为。

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3
programme.desc: 在《两条鲨鱼的故事》中,我们将看看南非海岸发现的各种各样的鲨鱼,重点关注濒临灭绝的路氏双髻鲨和标志性的大白鲨。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #1
programme.desc: 我們在本集認識一些動物長老,牠們幫我們瞭解與長壽相關的心理機制,以及長壽動物為其社區帶來的正面社會價值。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #2
programme.desc: 認識一些黃昏戀人,探索他們性長壽,以及晚年生育能力仍然旺盛的原因。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #3
programme.desc: 隨著動物老去,如何保持領導地位?我們調查作為一個狼群年老領導者所承擔的責任與挑戰。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #4
programme.desc: 我們探索老年動物對構成其群體是如何不可或缺,並研究動物在其生命過程中如何學習。

programme.title: 動物長青術 #5
programme.desc: 人類、植物、動物、細菌,都有一個避無可避的共通點: 死亡。我們在本集發現老化的動物如何違背我們對生命周期的常理認知。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #1
programme.desc: 認識新任野外戰士義工,他們將加入韋札的動物大家庭。變髒是工作的一部分。當然,隨時會有衝擊性的驚喜。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #2
programme.desc: 我們在本集目睹一場拯救一隻受驚黑高角羚的絕望任務。這些反偷獵的大象智慧震驚所有人。而且,總能忙裡偷閒。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #3
programme.desc: 義工們在本集近距離接觸標誌性的動物。深入瞭解韋札的反偷獵成就。還有,努力無堅不摧。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #4
programme.desc: 義工們探索社區在保育中扮演的角色,包括令人興奮的蜂蜜收成、新團員的加入,以及其中一人餵哺黑犀牛的夢想成真。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #5
programme.desc: 在引人入勝的本集,雷利分享他放生犀牛的夢想。茱迪心愛的麂羚是時候回歸大自然。例行的東非條紋羚捕捉行動發生意想不到的轉折。

programme.title: 野生動物守衛員 #6
programme.desc: 在本集一個疣豬回收行動出了差錯。來認識韋札保育區的母系社會,一頭奇特大象的獨家故事。是時候告別韋札的家人。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #1
programme.desc: 來認識這些異常的微型動物,牠們利用嬌小的身軀在世上最致命的環境中克險求生。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #2
programme.desc: 體型異常龐大的動物就需要異常的適應力。從巨大的鯨魚到森林怪物,這些就是自然巨人的史詩式生存故事。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #3
programme.desc: 日入而作可帶來極端的挑戰,同時亦帶來巨大的機會。在這沒有光的世界,危險在每個角落蟄伏。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #4
programme.desc: 當冬季來臨,氣溫驟降,食物亦變得稀缺。但有些動物已經進化出獨特的適應力,能夠在世上最冷、最貧瘠的環境中繁衍。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 2 #5
programme.desc: 這些動物生活在極端環境中,卻創造出巧妙的工具和技術來為生存應對最嚴峻的挑戰。

programme.title: 大白鯊的秘密

programme.desc: 跟我們一起前往哥斯達黎加的心臟,發現幾個伊甸園般的美妙生物群落,並察看每天保育,有時則是恢復這一特別自然遺產前所未有的努力。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #1
programme.desc: 葡萄牙多元化的地貌孕育了獨特的野生生態。從南部的西班牙栓皮櫟森林到北部的落葉林,從交配到野外生存,跟隨標誌性物種所經歷的關鍵生命階段。

programme.title: 葡萄牙野外 #2
programme.desc: 河流是葡萄牙野生生態的生命線,連接山脈到大海。探索成年雄鹿、青蛙的春季儀式和鸊鷉的舞蹈,還有這些生機勃勃的水道沿岸上其他動物和地貌。

programme.desc: 葡萄牙沿海水域和亞速爾群島擁有豐富的生態系統。在本集探索生活在這些水域的多元化物種,並發掘牠們獨特的生活。

programme.title: 荒野生存之道 #1
programme.desc: 由牠們的齒與爪,到令人難以置信的隱身和狡猾,大自然最致命的掠食者進化出一系列令人震驚的狩獵技術。

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt travels to the moors above Whitby on the Yorkshire Coast to treat Bobo, an eight-year-old Capuchin Meanwhile Samantha the scarlet macaw rules the roost and is displaying complete disobedience

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Inspector Anthony Joynes arranges a warrant to rescue four dogs from a dangerously overcrowded house After an unfriendly welcome it becomes clear that at least one of the dogs will need medical attention but their diagnosis turns out much more serious than expected

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.title: Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: We've scoured the internet to bring you the most hilarious clips of Budgies (and other birds) on the planet, not so much -§who's a clever boy-¨ as -§who's a funny boy-¨! Flying fails, performing Parrots and the real life angry birds -V we've assembled the very best the web has to offer, guaranteed to make you laugh out loud

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.title: 蒙面俠蘇洛2: 不朽傳奇
programme.desc: 即使嘗試保持低調,但對加州即將來臨的重大威脅,促使熱愛冒險的亞歷山卓穆瑞塔(班德拉斯飾)和他的妻子艾琳娜(薛達-鍾斯飾)採取行動。

programme.title: 命運好好玩
programme.desc: 一位工作狂建築師找到一個萬能遙控,能讓他快轉和快退到人生的不同部分。

programme.title: 雙龍會
programme.desc: 一對從小失散的同卵雙胞胎——一位是居住在紐約的音樂家,另一位是生活在香港的技工——多年後因音樂家的演奏會行程來到香港,意外重逢,引發一連串錯綜有趣的事件。

programme.title: 世界大對戰
programme.desc: 在這場視覺上壯觀的動作冒險遊戲中,一群意想不到的前 80 年代電子遊戲冠軍挺身而出,拯救世界免於外星人入侵。

programme.title: 最後的屠龍者
programme.desc: 在一個魔法息微,科技盛行的世界裡,15歲的珍妮花史傳奇經營著一家魔術師招聘公司,並發現最後一條龍正被獵殺。

programme.title: 3D 王牌小間諜
programme.desc: 時間所剩無多!退休間諜瑪莉莎(潔西卡·艾巴 飾)重出江湖,當一名反派威脅要讓全世界陷入冰封危機時,她必須再次出擊!在繼子女的協助與各種酷炫裝備的幫助下,他們展開一場與時間賽跑的精彩冒險——這是一部充滿動作與家庭樂趣的《3D 王牌小間諜》電影!

programme.title: 魔鬼剋星
programme.desc: 超自然現象愛好者艾比、愛琳、吉琳安和帕蒂開始捉鬼,她們意識到有人試圖在紐約市招魂來引發世界末日。

programme.title: 小子難纏 3
programme.desc: 身無分文的約翰克里斯遭到放逐,他試圖在一位越戰戰友的幫助下向丹尼爾和宮城報仇,這位戰友是一家有毒廢料處理公司的有錢老闆。

programme.title: 超難搞先生
programme.desc: 一名火爆的鰥夫與新鄰居建立起改變他生活的不可思議友誼。

programme.title: 全民情聖
programme.desc: 紐約「約會醫生」亞歷克斯赫金斯(韋史密夫飾)試圖吸引八卦專欄作家莎拉梅拉絲(伊娃曼德絲飾),同時他也指導害羞的阿爾伯特(凱文占士飾)如何贏得美麗女繼承人阿萊格拉科爾(琥珀瓦萊塔飾)的芳心。

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #2

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #3

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #97
programme.desc: 科學班的成員陸續遭偽裝成安東尼的露露貝爾和無數惡魔不斷襲擊。亞連一行人察覺到惡魔的存在後趕往研究室,卻因為大門被堵住而無法進入。對方的目標是否就是工廠的「卵」?

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #99
programme.desc: 元帥們以壓倒性的力量將惡魔們一網打盡,接著他們試圖摧毀「卵」。米蘭達卻因為突然被關在由地面噴出的水柱中而痛苦掙扎。而這道來歷不明的水柱在震驚的眾人面前化為一名女子的模樣。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #1
programme.desc: 喜歡強者,對弱者沒興趣的孤獨不良高中生櫻遙,為了爬上不良學校風鈴高中的頂點,從鎮「外」來到這裡。櫻在商店街從混混手中救下的少女琴葉,請他到波特斯咖啡廳吃飯作為報答,卻直言他無法爬上頂點。氣憤的櫻在隨後了解到她話中的真意及「風鈴的現狀」。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #22
programme.desc: 在出發前往宮崎前,阿奎亞與佳奈一同出門購物。在阿奎亞周到的安排下,佳奈開心得手足無措…。另一方面,失去揪出父親這個目標的阿奎亞則是向小茜坦白說出…

programme.title: 我推的孩子 #23
programme.desc: 睽違10多年,阿奎亞再度踏上過去吾郎與紗理奈生活過、亦是阿奎亞與露比的出生之地的宮崎,阿奎亞回顧著吾郎的人生軌跡。另一方面,心裡一直深藏對吾郎心意的露比卻…。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #98
programme.desc: 進入研究室的亞連和書人與無數惡魔交戰。然而亞連最終被接二連三出現的惡魔擋住去路,書人則被黏至牆壁並遭結晶化。在這段期間,露露貝爾偷走了卵,同伴們接連犧牲。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #99

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #1
programme.desc: 喜歡強者,對弱者沒興趣的孤獨不良高中生櫻遙,為了爬上不良學校風鈴高中的頂點,從鎮「外」來到這裡。櫻在商店街從混混手中救下的少女琴葉,請他到波特斯咖啡廳吃飯作為報答,卻直言他無法爬上頂點。氣憤的櫻在隨後了解到她話中的真意及「風鈴的現狀」。

programme.desc: 突然出現在亞連面前的林克監察官表示自己是奉教團之命前來監視。亞連對林克所說的話感到動搖,他透過玻璃窗戶看到奏者的影子映照在自己身後。另一邊,利娜莉遇到魯貝里亞,童年記憶因此被喚醒。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #97
programme.desc: 科學班的成員陸續遭偽裝成安東尼的露露貝爾和無數惡魔不斷襲擊。亞連一行人察覺到惡魔的存在後趕往研究室,卻因為大門被堵住而無法進入。對方的目標是否就是工廠的「卵」?

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #98
programme.desc: 進入研究室的亞連和書人與無數惡魔交戰。然而亞連最終被接二連三出現的惡魔擋住去路,書人則被黏至牆壁並遭結晶化。在這段期間,露露貝爾偷走了卵,同伴們接連犧牲。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #99
programme.desc: 元帥們以壓倒性的力量將惡魔們一網打盡,接著他們試圖摧毀「卵」。米蘭達卻因為突然被關在由地面噴出的水柱中而痛苦掙扎。而這道來歷不明的水柱在震驚的眾人面前化為一名女子的模樣。

programme.title: 驅魔少年 #100
programme.desc: 等級4的惡魔最終還是誕生了,亞連目睹被其當成內臟的人類靈魂,已不成人形的樣子使他不忍直視。他為了拯救靈魂而對等級4的惡魔發動攻擊,但招式全都被閃避。對方壓倒性的強大力量使亞連持劍的手開始顫抖。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #1
programme.desc: 為了抗衡來自天界的攻勢,惡魔「阿久津雅虎」前來人間尋找具備領袖特質、能拯救魔界的人才。他隱藏自己的真實身份,轉學至某所高中就讀並遇到了可愛的美少女「天音莉莉」。阿久津認為她可能就是能拯救魔界的「人類」,於是便向她提出邀約,然而……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #2
programme.desc: 阿久津被莉莉制服並成為了她的僕人,被迫協助她狩獵惡魔。阿久津拒絕協助,並表示他寧願被淨化也不願殺死自己的同類。於是莉莉便啟動了套在阿久津頸上的「奪走自由並施以懲罰的頸圈的力量」。然後,阿久津的身體就不由自主地開始動了起來……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #3
programme.desc: 阿久津帥氣地救出了在街上被搭訕的莉莉。儘管對遲到的阿久津感到生氣,兩人卻依舊直接前往約會……不,是前往狩獵惡魔。莉莉懷疑最近頻繁發生的野犬襲擊事件是惡魔的所為,於是她便和阿久津一同在街道中展開探索。然而,卻有一道殺氣騰騰的目光正注視著他們。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #4
programme.desc: 莉莉遇到了獸型惡魔,並與其展開了激烈的戰鬥。阿久津因夾在同族與莉莉之間而陷入兩難,他為了想辦法平息事態而介入了他們的戰鬥。然而,同族卻將阿久津視為叛徒,而莉莉則警告阿久津不要妨礙她,不然就將他給淨化。這時,被逼到絕境的阿久津思考出了一個辦法。

programme.title: 重啟人生的千金小姐正在攻略龍帝陛下 #7
programme.desc: 「軍神千金」吉兒被未婚夫王太子傑拉爾德陷害入獄並因此喪命,但回過神來竟發現自己回到與未婚夫初見的那晚。為了避開人生最糟選擇,吉兒決定要與未來的暴君,實則純真的鄰國皇帝哈迪斯結婚,並立志要幫他重新做人。重啟人生的千金,她的大逆轉劇就此開幕。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #3
programme.desc: 以打架聞名的強者全聚集在一年一班。無視於一旁慌張的榆井及冷靜旁觀的蘇枋隼飛,櫻與被他惹怒的杉下京太郎展開了一場豪邁的戰鬥。但防風鈴的總長梅宮一高分貝的聲音打斷了他們的攻防。當櫻等人神情緊張地仰望著擴音器時,等到的卻是梅宮出乎意料的一番話。

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #1
programme.desc: 魔法使少女「伊多拉阿波羅」每天在宅邸中替冒險者進行試煉,然而結果總是令人失望。就在此時,被譽為期待新星的「淺垣燈悟」現身了。他那神秘又俐落的動作和姿勢究竟會展現出怎麼樣的實力?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #2
programme.desc: 與伊多拉締結羈絆的淺垣燈悟前往冒險者公會登錄戰隊。而就在這時,伊多拉卻遭到冒險者辱罵,因為她那位曾是王家之杖卻被稱為「膽小鬼」的父親。就在衝突一觸即發之際,燈悟竟提議要用任務來一決勝負?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #3
programme.desc: 阿瓦魯羅斯特帝國的王女「蒂露緹娜」及侍從「羅吉米斯特」前來拜訪。他們請伊多拉協助分析及回收「魔力之種」,但羅吉似乎不願讓燈悟同行。結果兩人竟要透過戰鬥展現各自的實力?

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #2
programme.desc: 風鈴高中蛻變成守護城鎮的學校而被稱為「防風鈴」。開學典禮一早,與櫻同屆的活潑少年榆井秋彥,為了讓琴葉看他穿上夢寐以求的風鈴高中制服而衝進波特斯。他極其開朗的言行,和商店街人們展現出的溫柔態度,都讓櫻感到困惑。就在此時,突然有人抓住櫻求救。

programme.title: WIND BREAKER—防風少年— #3
programme.desc: 以打架聞名的強者全聚集在一年一班。無視於一旁慌張的榆井及冷靜旁觀的蘇枋隼飛,櫻與被他惹怒的杉下京太郎展開了一場豪邁的戰鬥。但防風鈴的總長梅宮一高分貝的聲音打斷了他們的攻防。當櫻等人神情緊張地仰望著擴音器時,等到的卻是梅宮出乎意料的一番話。

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #1
programme.desc: 魔法使少女「伊多拉阿波羅」每天在宅邸中替冒險者進行試煉,然而結果總是令人失望。就在此時,被譽為期待新星的「淺垣燈悟」現身了。他那神秘又俐落的動作和姿勢究竟會展現出怎麼樣的實力?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #2
programme.desc: 與伊多拉締結羈絆的淺垣燈悟前往冒險者公會登錄戰隊。而就在這時,伊多拉卻遭到冒險者辱罵,因為她那位曾是王家之杖卻被稱為「膽小鬼」的父親。就在衝突一觸即發之際,燈悟竟提議要用任務來一決勝負?

programme.title: 紅戰士在異世界成了冒險者 #3
programme.desc: 阿瓦魯羅斯特帝國的王女「蒂露緹娜」及侍從「羅吉米斯特」前來拜訪。他們請伊多拉協助分析及回收「魔力之種」,但羅吉似乎不願讓燈悟同行。結果兩人竟要透過戰鬥展現各自的實力?

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際) 外匯交易平台呈獻：環球新聞檔案粵
電影多啦A夢：大雄與天空的理想鄉粵日
programme.desc: 大雄聽出木衫講述世界各地的烏托邦傳說，產生無限憧憬，並說服多啦A夢帶他展開尋找烏托邦之旅。眾人乘上時光飛船，循昔日的相關報導搜索各個時空，最後真的發現飄浮於天空上的帕樂達國。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#18粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘潛入區府尋找線索險被發現，幸得林世顯解圍，原來他是區家二公子。十一娘為母親做法事，蓮房心虛受驚，意外暴露她與元娘之死有關。區勵行為了破壞衛國公和徐令宜的關係，設計讓王煜看上衛國公的義女蓮頌。

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: 繼續有兩位重量級嘉賓：張衛健及麥長青！踏入新一年，四人一邊燒和牛一邊回顧過去，展望將來，三師兄弟更大爆當年拍攝西遊記的鮮為人知的甜酸苦辣！

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 進入新的一年，不少人都會訂立新目標，但根據「經驗」，有部份人會難於完成新年所訂立的大計。臨床心理學家提供訂立目標的建議，並講述如何維持動力去執行。相信「身體健康」是大部份人的其中一個目標，今集亦請到心臟科醫生，提供愛護心臟的小貼士，當中包括要脫離肥胖、改善飲食、持續定期進行中高強度運動，醫生還有甚麼護心秘訣可以分享？新一年以美食慰勞自己，「睇餸食飯」傅季馨提出用「焗釀蟹蓋」為新年作個好開始。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 脫牙會增加認知障礙風險？嘉賓區永權、陳庭欣、吳幸美、蔡康年分析時都現嚴重「語障」，還是請牙科醫生講解咀嚼過程與認知功能的關係，腦神經科專科醫生亦會講解認知障礙症的患病原因。即場做一項認知小測試，題目中的動物圖案已令嘉賓迷惘？講到柏金遜症的病徵，康年突然「拋書包」，有料到！兩種「腦」毛病有何差別？再派出庭欣與幸美進行柏金遜症小測試。中醫亦帶來一款健腦益智湯水，嘉賓辨別藥材同時，亦了解天麻的補腦功效。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#28粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)冠一向駿昇交代柏義最新情況，駿昇勸他盡快返港陪正花。正花因擔心胎兒早產，徹夜難眠。冠一與同門慶功時，收到正花來電，但傳來竟是兆良的聲音，他以正花及胎兒要脅冠一在二十四小時內從獄中救出柏義。冠一助柏義逃獄，柏義卻不肯透露正花在哪裏，眾同門偷偷地去救正花，卻誤入兆良的陷阱。柏義迫冠一玩死亡遊戲，並直播給眾人觀看；林磊趁駿昇看直播時，突然想把駿昇從高處推下去；兆良則準備殺死正花腹中胎兒……

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子開生日會，媽媽勒令只能邀請五人出席，更指定其中三人為丸尾、花輪和小翠，令小丸子大為頭痛。小丸子想養禾雀，費盡心思終於說服父母，誰知禾雀售罄，小丸子不願等，於是買了十姊妹回家。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 到了出新茶的季節，一向對茶味有要求的小丸子迫不及待叫媽媽買新茶，並到小玉家裡品嚐她們家嘅新茶。學校參觀日將至，小丸子企圖隱瞞卻被媽媽發現，最後只能認命，盡力在課堂上作出好表現。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，這次需要用上瑜伽墊、兩塊瑜伽磚，來配合做運動。將腿部屈曲、壓低，稍作熱身，就可正式訓練。躺下後用單腳腳掌舉高瑜伽磚，再做手肘碰膝蓋等動作，能保持穩定不弄跌瑜伽磚嗎？及後要用大腿及前臂夾緊瑜伽磚，再將雙腳輪流伸直，都有助強化核心肌群。為了訓練下肢穩定性，要準備好雙腳長時間抬起並呈現屈曲90度的狀態，還有腿部伸直、跨過瑜伽磚的練習，對改善腿型有一定幫助。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 進入新的一年，不少人都會訂立新目標，但根據「經驗」，有部份人會難於完成新年所訂立的大計。臨床心理學家提供訂立目標的建議，並講述如何維持動力去執行。相信「身體健康」是大部份人的其中一個目標，今集亦請到心臟科醫生，提供愛護心臟的小貼士，當中包括要脫離肥胖、改善飲食、持續定期進行中高強度運動，醫生還有甚麼護心秘訣可以分享？新一年以美食慰勞自己，「睇餸食飯」傅季馨提出用「焗釀蟹蓋」為新年作個好開始。

programme.title: 乘勝狙擊#28粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)冠一向駿昇交代柏義最新情況，駿昇勸他盡快返港陪正花。正花因擔心胎兒早產，徹夜難眠。冠一與同門慶功時，收到正花來電，但傳來竟是兆良的聲音，他以正花及胎兒要脅冠一在二十四小時內從獄中救出柏義。冠一助柏義逃獄，柏義卻不肯透露正花在哪裏，眾同門偷偷地去救正花，卻誤入兆良的陷阱。柏義迫冠一玩死亡遊戲，並直播給眾人觀看；林磊趁駿昇看直播時，突然想把駿昇從高處推下去；兆良則準備殺死正花腹中胎兒……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#7粵
programme.desc: 藥房熟客漸被宇生搶去，高慶不滿，妙喜被無理取鬧，提出讓高慶當家。高慶成為當家，購入多項「特價產品」，高家眾人苦不堪言。眾人提議他參加瑜珈班分散他視線，不過其後眾人發現高慶為家中添置數箱過期的罐頭乾貨。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#18粵普

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 麥長青帶同檸檬汁，說要去除依附在地毯上的頑固紅酒漬，牆上的筆漬又怎樣去除？不同品牌的啤酒樽蓋也有21個鋸齒，此數字有甚麼玄機？啤酒有特異功能，可在植物及人頭上起作用！巧妙折曲衣架，輕易變身萬用掛架！

programme.title: 乜都搞掂晒粵
programme.desc: 冰凍汽水人人愛，忘了把汽水放雪櫃？來一盆冰水，30秒便可「急凍」它！飲料倒出來有時會濺得滿桌都是，掌握簡單技巧便輕鬆解決。女士也可極速換燈膽、鑽牆兼不傷手？留意香香示範！倒數小小麵包袋夾的實用五強。

programme.desc: 有義頭頭碰著黑，相士蘇人中為他測出「狗離不得、雞碰不得」。有義認定福星瘟神正是有朋及溢滿。有義即對有朋獻殷勤，疏遠溢滿。有義後和盤托出實情，溢滿與有義以賽馬日「第九場九號」能否勝出作賭注，迫有義道歉。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 順德大良以飼養水牛聞名，以水牛奶做成的牛乳和雙皮奶，奶味尤其香濃。鼎爺帶阿譚見識手工牛乳的製作工序後「煮意」大發，巧製鮮甜滋味的「牛乳鯇片粥」，「自製鍋巴夾牛乳」則香脆可口。鍋巴怎樣才可炸得鬆化？阿譚手癢試炸，卻成了錯誤示範！「海南雞飯」雞滑、飯香，加上雞雜煮白菜湯，可謂完美配搭！鼎爺堅持選用新鮮黃薑入飯，它比黃薑粉有何優勝之處？此外，不論雪藏雞或冰鮮雞，均可煮出「鼎級」海南雞飯，關鍵又在哪裡？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老友記跌倒非同小可，由治療師、護士合作策劃與設計的「防跌舞」，為長者在生理上提升防跌能力之餘，還照顧其心理，從而減低他們的跌倒恐懼指數。相關計劃的代表示範防跌舞的多個基本動作，也會細說箇中的作用。灰甲是常見的都市病，困擾不少人士，如沒妥善處理，除了影響外觀，長遠還可引致更多健康問題。皮膚科醫生詳析治療方法，並提醒護理注意事項，以減少復發機會。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製暖笠笠菜式「臘味啫啫雞煲」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 馮盈盈與陳自瑤由鬥聲鬥到健康知識，今集來個血壓常識比拼！二人分別指出量血壓時的心境與姿勢要點，再由心臟科專科醫生補充與糾正；盈盈即場替自瑤量血壓，被醫生指唯一過錯是「騷擾」？甚麼不良生活習慣會導致高血壓？兩位副所長質疑自瑤的想法，自瑤為此更改答案，最後發現「中伏」！主動脈撕裂最常發生於身體甚麼位置？想控制血壓，飲食是其中一個要素，聽中醫介紹一款湯水，並了解當中的瑪卡和三七對控制血壓的功效。

programme.title: 陪著你走#1粵

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子問媽媽的寶物是什麼，後者拿出年輕時買的蛋白石指環，並透露已經由3萬升值至100萬。小玉和藤木來到小丸子家看指環，然後用指環玩遊戲，此時媽媽突然回家，一陣混亂過後，指環不知所蹤。

programme.title: Hands Up粵 及 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 玲玲姐姐希望有一碗暖暖的湯圓，以陪伴她度過寒冷天氣，新到來「Artspiration」的繪畫導師答應她的要求，第一步是在紙上畫兩點再勾勒笑容？導師帶來非一般的畫湯圓教學，會在湯圓上繪出可愛笑臉，詳情怎樣？主持姐姐分享2026年的新目標，孩子們也投稿「開心SHARE」夢想職業。有小朋友提到想成為太空人，引發眾主持對太空的奇想，Tiffany姐姐更想過在太空中或許會出現另一個自己。

programme.title: 宿敵契約#9粵普PG
programme.desc: 一笑想起曾聽到面具人提及給靜石送過一批銀兩，負責運送的是榮通鏢局，隨歌遂派人調查…一笑發現無影，追蹤她至死士營據點，無影正是當初訓練自己的死士營首領。無影欲殺一笑，一笑因聞到軟筋散渾身無力，命懸一線。

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 老友記跌倒非同小可，由治療師、護士合作策劃與設計的「防跌舞」，為長者在生理上提升防跌能力之餘，還照顧其心理，從而減低他們的跌倒恐懼指數。相關計劃的代表示範防跌舞的多個基本動作，也會細說箇中的作用。灰甲是常見的都市病，困擾不少人士，如沒妥善處理，除了影響外觀，長遠還可引致更多健康問題。皮膚科醫生詳析治療方法，並提醒護理注意事項，以減少復發機會。「睇餸食飯」，Annie炮製暖笠笠菜式「臘味啫啫雞煲」。

programme.title: 醫醫，我不想再病了粵
programme.desc: 馮盈盈與陳自瑤由鬥聲鬥到健康知識，今集來個血壓常識比拼！二人分別指出量血壓時的心境與姿勢要點，再由心臟科專科醫生補充與糾正；盈盈即場替自瑤量血壓，被醫生指唯一過錯是「騷擾」？甚麼不良生活習慣會導致高血壓？兩位副所長質疑自瑤的想法，自瑤為此更改答案，最後發現「中伏」！主動脈撕裂最常發生於身體甚麼位置？想控制血壓，飲食是其中一個要素，聽中醫介紹一款湯水，並了解當中的瑪卡和三七對控制血壓的功效。

programme.title: 陪著你走#1粵
programme.desc: 失明的宋天從由導盲犬「導生」引到商場，聽見廣告旁白，將片傳給男友杜正恆；推銷員將「愛是無所不能」天使匙扣給她。廣告創作總監甘言重想起三年前與好友余加勁宵夜之事。怕狗的言重離開便利店時卻遇上流浪狗……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#8粵
programme.desc: 有義頭頭碰著黑，相士蘇人中為他測出「狗離不得、雞碰不得」。有義認定福星瘟神正是有朋及溢滿。有義即對有朋獻殷勤，疏遠溢滿。有義後和盤托出實情，溢滿與有義以賽馬日「第九場九號」能否勝出作賭注，迫有義道歉。

programme.title: 錦心似玉#19粵普
programme.desc: 十一娘為了揭穿羅元娘的死與蓮房有關，不惜假懷孕，可惜事情露出馬腳，讓蓮房決定施計把十一娘趕走。令寬得知王煜與區勵行過從甚密，通知令宜，令宜聽從十一娘提議送令寬戲本以示獎勵, 十一娘對令宜更添好感。

programme.title: 區區開伙粵
programme.desc: 在太子及大角咀「掃街」，吃盡各省各地特色美食。愛吃但不胖的蔡思貝，推介邪惡美食及甜品，還帶大家走入經典漫畫人物主題餐廳。主持一試街坊爆冷之選「東北菜」，並跟糖妹試勻韓國空運燒烤食材及西歐主菜美食！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬對遊牧民族的生活同文化來說是不可或缺的。蒙古人更把馬放在他們的傳統樂器上，製成雙弦樂器馬頭琴馬頭琴獨特的旋律不旦可以觸動動物的心靈, 也喚醒了蒙古人的身份認同，讓傳統文化得以傳承。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 羊角村，被譽為荷蘭威尼斯的美麗村落，早期居民在挖煤炭時，竟挖出大量山羊角，以此命名。社區以船代車，與水共生。泰國柯叻島，三百年前的人造島，早期是榴槤產地，經常引發洪災，榴槤種植難以為繼，轉型為陶瓷島。

programme.title: 西葡潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 最後一集，芷珮玩盡葡萄牙南部海岸阿爾加維！出海划雙人獨木舟，沿途穿梭海峽、細賞蔚藍海洋，探索別有洞天的岩石奇觀，她會遇上甚麼刺激事？參觀葡國有二千年歷史的古羅馬遺跡，順道在小型博物館，了解這所古老大宅的過去。到訪軟木製作工場，窺探有趣的打造過程，搜羅酒塞、羽毛球、家品、包包、雨傘等激罕軟木製品！芷珮駕着復古露營車，展開公路旅行，停泊在海灘靜待夕陽，在車上主理簡單晚餐，度過輕鬆愜意的一天。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 大澳水鄉別具風情，長沙水清沙幼，風景宜人。陸浩明、許嘉傑、歐陽巧瑩、容羨媛嘗試從「立體」角度出發，欣賞不一樣的大嶼山風光。沿著虎山山脊拾級而上，大澳蔚藍海景一覽無遺；登上舢舨穿梭於棚屋之間，浪漫感覺媲美到訪歐洲威尼斯；置身於舊警署改建而成的文物酒店，可細味源自上世紀初的懷舊氣息；入住海邊主題民宿，足不出戶也可細賞鬧市難得一見的潮汐日落景色。幾位主持還來到沙灘大玩衝浪，散發青春活力。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 室內設計是指透過改善建築物內部的藝術與科學，為使用者營造更健康、更美觀的環境。谷主瀅仴詳述多種設計風格的特色，其中某種強調「少即是多」的概念，會是甚麼風格？還有近年新興的「侘寂風格」，其主張的「不完美的美」又是何意？谷主汛文公開其在加拿大的家居照片，並分享由媽媽設計的工業風地庫。眾谷主又淺談設計時應否為未來可能的需求預留空間，各有甚麼想法？瀅仴笑言數年後或會有結婚打算，因而被拍檔打趣調侃。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 勁歌金榜粵
programme.desc: 許文軒為觀眾倒數本星期「勁歌金榜」二十首上榜歌曲的排名位置，並相約歌手谷婭溦暢談音樂。

programme.title: 三餸一湯粵
programme.desc: 三姐帶來蓮藕兩食，先煲「蓮藕綠豆乳鴿湯」，蓮藕節、皮部位的營養尤其豐富；另將蓮藕切件，用南乳混腐乳燜煮，然後炸至金黃色，配合香炸薑絲做出「金絲蓮藕」。三姐燜蓮藕時特別加入紅麴米，有何作用？「味菜雞柳燴魚肚」匯聚焦香雞肉與開胃味菜，三姐在蝦膠「加料」，令口感更爽脆。緊接三姐傳授新鮮豬皮的處理方法，經過火燒、汆水、切花的步驟，再釀入墨魚膠和雞蓉先煎後蒸；以上湯、蛋白調製琉璃芡，這道「釀豬皮」甚考功夫！

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 招浩明請嘉賓伍詠薇用嘴加持，帶來換啤牌魔術；再與觀眾互動，展現神奇預知能力！陳乙僮獻唱<黃色大門用錯發聲位，獲嘉賓蔡一傑傳授歌唱貼士。姜嘉琳送上歌舞劇表演，卻被評咬字不清，能否過關？挫敗也可成追夢契機，前空姐吳洛汶實現台上唱歌的心願，盼藉<逃生門感動大家。入行多年的黃建東，仍有一團演藝火，冀以鋼琴彈唱、Rap唱獲得認同。繆家慶同樣自彈自唱，透過抵死創作<陽過訴說「中招隔離」心聲，笑住抗疫！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 腫瘤科醫生莫樹錦接受壓力程度測試，得分竟然是0！讓他最感壓力的會是哪一刻？莫醫生還抱有一個「奇怪」的人生觀，這是壓力零分的心得嗎？壓力可引致痛症，在脊醫指引下進行空罐測試及肩關節痛症幅度測試，簡單舉手即可測出肩膊狀況。按摩時配合香薰精油，也有舒緩功效，留意香薰治療師的複方建議。氣味能夠掀起人的回憶，並影響情緒，臨床心理學家帶來四款物品，讓主持透過嗅覺放鬆一陣。此外，從偏好的氣味，更可測出壓力來源？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 後空翻少年粵日
programme.desc: 初中最後一個夏天，雙葉翔太郎偶然認識了男子韻律體操這項運動，不覺被它深深吸引。翌年，雙葉入讀私立蒼秀館高中，並向男子韻律體操隊叩門，這裡不但有一眾別具個性的前輩，還有與他同年的初中體操明星美里良夜。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 久坐對身體不好，既然功課做完了，不妨跟兒童體適能教練一同動起來！先做深蹲及「無影櫈」動作，考驗大家的下肢肌耐力。地上放一個雪糕筒，利用核心肌群發力，提起腳部跨過雪糕筒；如想增加穩定度，可試試叉腰做。最後加上原地跳練習，第一階段訓練就可完成。休息過後，輪到針對柔軟度的運動。坐於瑜伽墊上，先將雙腳伸直，嘗試彎腰讓雙手碰到腳尖，再做扭腰、蝴蝶式、雙手扣緊向外拉、大字伸展等動作，看看誰人要改善柔軟度？

programme.title: 成語動畫廊粵
programme.desc: 《成語動畫廊》以動畫手法解說漢語成語的教育片，通過趣味濃厚的動畫，讓大家分享中國文化的獨有寶藏。

programme.title: 科學×冒險 絕境求生手冊粵日
programme.desc: 眼見讓風力發電廠將要運作時，竟突然發生雪崩，令發電廠瞬間毀壞。幸好還有一個方法，就是潮汐發電。可是礙於潮汐的特性，一天就只有兩次機會。智悟堅定決心，矢志終結大停電，奪回光明的世界。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 天氣轉冷，外面有小販車出售煨番薯。小丸子滿心歡喜拉爺爺外出購買，爺爺卻忘記帶銀包，令小丸子與煨番薯緣慳一面。小丸子對此事耿耿於懷，翌日上學也談起這件事，豬太郎則說那架小販車會在某處定時出現……

programme.title: 榮寶齋粵
programme.desc: 節目聚焦榮寶齋代代堅守、薪火相傳的百年歷程，透過榮寶齋這一中國文化與藝術發展的重要縮影，展現中國傳統文化的魅力與蓬勃的生命力。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
香港中旅集團呈獻：新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 宏福苑五級火過去一個多月，災民除了身體的創傷，心靈的傷口也需時癒合。有人痛失摯愛，有人失去家園，他們如何療癒內心創傷？截至12月31日，今次火災造成最少161人死亡，是本港史上最嚴重的住宅火警事故。除了宏福苑居民，不少港人情緒亦受到影響，市民需要警惕哪些訊號？由個人到社會，香港如何走出陰霾？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 女神玩轉嘉年華粵
programme.desc: 五對「女神」CP重聚，盡情玩轉遊戲。坐上海盜船，俊其要用水槍射甩毓儀臉上的紫菜，卻一味尖叫？展望瘋狂掃射，蒨文預告「今晚加倍奉還」！焌堯釋放野獸一面，水柱衝擊芷晴美顏。男士矇眼自轉，以指定器皿倒水進女神頭上水杯，表達「520」心聲。嘉敏被家俊以「瀑布」淋頭，一直叫停都無用……揀中超長嘴水壺一組，可謂地獄級難度！輪到女神矇眼玩遊戲，敏巧鯨吞啟進身上的車厘子，玩到「吐血」；某男笑得開懷，恍如自肥時間？

programme.title: 無雙粵PG
programme.desc: 偽鈔集團神秘首腦一手挖掘落魄畫家李問加入自己的偽鈔團隊,用高超的造假技術製作出真假難辨的偽鈔,引起警方高度重視然而,神秘首腦和其他成員的身份一直成謎,警方的破案進度遭受了前所未有的挑戰

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 2025年本港舉行了不少國際級盛事，還首次與廣東、澳門聯合承辦全運會，加上啟德體育園正式啟用，為體育界掀起新一頁，這集回顧香港體壇大事。香港馬拉松將於1月18日舉行，大會推行「助小店撐跑手」計劃，邀全港多區餐飲食店參與，冀將盛事經濟帶動至社區，同時為跑手打氣。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 招商局集團特約：天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 中信股份呈獻：財經透視粵
programme.desc: 日本改裝車文化曾經盛極一時，「東京改裝車展」早前首度來港舉行，亦吸引了不少車迷入場。三位「季度大比拼」的投資專家，過去一年在港股和美股的模擬投資，最後成績如何？

programme.title: 新鮮人#23粵
programme.desc: Raymond再插莊嫁禍家輝，家輝苦無證據，唯有忍痛將心血賣給志遠的財團。麗華找Raymond求情被戲弄，時楊定中出現替她出頭，原來自家輝裝修後便風山水起，他一直希望報答。家輝突然向麗華示愛，麗華不知所措。志遠、少嫻上門找家輝傾談合作，少嫻見浩浩之頸鏈，即斷定她是失散的女兒。家謙本準備陪韋文倒數生日，阮盈卻突然出現，稱患上絕症。韋文一直等家謙，惜再次失望。家謙陪伴病重的阮盈，阮盈感動。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 大澳水鄉別具風情，長沙水清沙幼，風景宜人。陸浩明、許嘉傑、歐陽巧瑩、容羨媛嘗試從「立體」角度出發，欣賞不一樣的大嶼山風光。沿著虎山山脊拾級而上，大澳蔚藍海景一覽無遺；登上舢舨穿梭於棚屋之間，浪漫感覺媲美到訪歐洲威尼斯；置身於舊警署改建而成的文物酒店，可細味源自上世紀初的懷舊氣息；入住海邊主題民宿，足不出戶也可細賞鬧市難得一見的潮汐日落景色。幾位主持還來到沙灘大玩衝浪，散發青春活力。

programme.title: 全城一叮粵
programme.desc: 招浩明請嘉賓伍詠薇用嘴加持，帶來換啤牌魔術；再與觀眾互動，展現神奇預知能力！陳乙僮獻唱<黃色大門用錯發聲位，獲嘉賓蔡一傑傳授歌唱貼士。姜嘉琳送上歌舞劇表演，卻被評咬字不清，能否過關？挫敗也可成追夢契機，前空姐吳洛汶實現台上唱歌的心願，盼藉<逃生門感動大家。入行多年的黃建東，仍有一團演藝火，冀以鋼琴彈唱、Rap唱獲得認同。繆家慶同樣自彈自唱，透過抵死創作<陽過訴說「中招隔離」心聲，笑住抗疫！

programme.title: 你想減壓粵
programme.desc: 腫瘤科醫生莫樹錦接受壓力程度測試，得分竟然是0！讓他最感壓力的會是哪一刻？莫醫生還抱有一個「奇怪」的人生觀，這是壓力零分的心得嗎？壓力可引致痛症，在脊醫指引下進行空罐測試及肩關節痛症幅度測試，簡單舉手即可測出肩膊狀況。按摩時配合香薰精油，也有舒緩功效，留意香薰治療師的複方建議。氣味能夠掀起人的回憶，並影響情緒，臨床心理學家帶來四款物品，讓主持透過嗅覺放鬆一陣。此外，從偏好的氣味，更可測出壓力來源？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 馬對遊牧民族的生活同文化來說是不可或缺的。蒙古人更把馬放在他們的傳統樂器上，製成雙弦樂器馬頭琴馬頭琴獨特的旋律不旦可以觸動動物的心靈, 也喚醒了蒙古人的身份認同，讓傳統文化得以傳承。

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 羊角村，被譽為荷蘭威尼斯的美麗村落，早期居民在挖煤炭時，竟挖出大量山羊角，以此命名。社區以船代車，與水共生。泰國柯叻島，三百年前的人造島，早期是榴槤產地，經常引發洪災，榴槤種植難以為繼，轉型為陶瓷島。

programme.title: 月月、阿奇與小墨：森林保衛隊GO
programme.desc: 當小動物們需要幫助，貓頭鷹月月、河狸阿奇和章魚小墨組成的森林保衛隊就會出動，結合海陸空視角制定完美計劃！因為幫助他人不只是對的事，也是有趣的事！森林保衛隊GO！

programme.title: 彼得與狼奇遇記
programme.desc: 擅長解決問題的小學生彼得，在路上救了一隻狼後，意外展開穿越時空的奇幻冒險！勇者與惡龍、精靈與半人馬、複製人與隱形人……彼得與狼的精采奇遇，就此展開！

programme.title: 媽媽要出嫁
programme.desc: 【任勞任怨大半輩子的慈母覺醒切割貪財不孝子】因丈夫早逝，獨自撫養四名子女的尹正愛，就如同天下所有的媽媽一樣，為了孩子總是願意犧牲自己，一路從路邊的菜販打拼，多年後與大女兒允姬開了間點心餐廳。正當一切都看似幸福美滿時，孩子們的婚姻、事業、學業紛紛出現狀況，在面對問題時兒女們總持相反意見，並只貪圖母親的遺產，讓正愛深感背叛，在朋友的勸說下，正愛打算不再以孩子為生活重心，並在緣分安排下開始了第二春。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【王牌律師X怪物新人法律界最強拍檔真相一觸即發！】在韓國頂尖律師事務所KANG&HAM，崔江錫是無人能敵的王牌律師，精準果敢、戰無不勝。一次偶然，他遇見高延宇──沒有法學背景、未取得律師執照，卻擁有怪物般的驚人記憶力。慧眼識珠的江錫破格將他納入團隊，從此兩人成為法律界最強黃金拍檔。在法庭上縱橫捭闔、揭露真相與陰謀，他們並肩作戰，也建立深厚情誼，並在愛與抉擇間踏上命運的新篇章。

programme.title: 追蹤者
programme.desc: 【國稅廳版文森佐任時完熱血復仇】全台首播，任職於頂尖會計事務所的黃東柱，實力超群，年紀輕輕就坐上組長的位子，在父親墜海身亡以意外結案後，整理遺物的東柱發現，紀錄大企業逃稅的本子憑空消失了，他火速考上地方國稅局。靠著揭發知名球星的逃稅案，立馬成為國稅局的當紅炸子雞，本以為能離真相更近，卻被調職到「國稅廳5局」，這個被大家稱作垃圾場的單位，而他又該如何率領團隊深入調查，找到真正的殺父仇人呢?

programme.title: 歐若拉公主
programme.desc: 【落難千金嫁到三位「惡婆婆」家，受盡欺辱卻迷的兩位男神團團轉！】該劇以豪爽純潔的愛情故事繼續展開，故事發生在大公司名門之女歐若拉遇見與三個姐姐一起生活的完美但挑剔的小說家黃瑪瑪。

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋
programme.desc: 【狠心母拋家嫁富豪棄子重生只為揭穿母親真面目】一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火。年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬。她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世、母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與「繼孫女」的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具。母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言、親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決。

programme.title: 聖水洞之吻
programme.desc: 【年下實習生朴所羅門戀年上工作狂金智恩，吻出姊弟戀化學效應！！】業界能力頂級的行銷組組長姜娜恩，雖是個性冷血的工作狂，但能交出亮眼的工作成績單。遇上公司內MZ世代又期待戀愛的實習生蘇恩浩，兩人上年下的相處，因年齡及價值觀不同互相嫌棄。卻因意外接吻捲入「靈魂交換」事件。之後兩人會發生什麼有趣的事呢?

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: 好好生活
programme.desc: 【霸道總裁《飛狐外傳》林雨申戀上俏鄰居《光芒》蔡文靜！】吳憂因車禍意外放男友鴿子慘遭分手，而同樣在這場車禍中喪命的是雅曼生物科技總裁何西亞的未婚妻陸芸。吳憂分手後寄情於工作，投入新職場認識了陸芸的妹妹陸蔓，成為了閨蜜。在公事上與何西亞有了合作，不打不相識的這對歡喜冤家，好不容易發展成為戀人,此時發現陸芸在他們之間串連起來的緣分…

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 紅天機
programme.desc: 【國民妹妹金裕貞，百搭安孝燮x孔明x郭時暘眾多男神演員！！】朝鮮時代進入景福宮的絕世美女畫工紅天機（金裕貞飾），和失明但可以讀懂天空和星座的觀象監河覽（安孝燮飾），風流倜儻的亮明大君（孔明飾)，夢想成為王的周向大君(郭時暘飾)，掌握生死的三神及被封印人類的魔王同時存在展開的奇幻愛情古裝劇。

programme.title: SOS！小仙女曼曼
programme.desc: 在魔法王國，不論是穿不下玻璃鞋、被三隻小豬欺負，還是遇到壞女巫，只要大喊「SOS！小仙女曼曼」，小仙女曼曼就會用雨傘魔杖為你解決問題！

programme.desc: 韓國教育電視台EBS製作的寓教於樂卡通，可輕鬆認識大自然的樣貌。神秘事件在森林裡發生，栗子莫名消失，昆蟲朋友離奇失蹤，皮特、巴巴、茉莉對這些事件展開調查。帶著偵探精神一起度過難關，在繁忙的調查過程中，共同學習、共同成長，創造學習樂趣。

programme.title: 豬豬俠大電影－海洋日記

programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 最佳愛情
programme.desc: 【知名編劇「洪氏姊妹」執筆當紅VS過氣偶像間的戀愛羅曼史】正值演藝巔峰的獨孤振，不但是廣告界寵兒，更是國民好感度第一的男星！而具愛貞則是前當紅偶像團體「國寶少女」成員，因過氣只好跑跑通告維持生計。獨孤振在一次試鏡中，因英語程度不佳，丟失了出演機會，沒想到這丟人的祕密，居然被具愛貞給知道了！國民喜愛的男星碰上國民唾棄的女星，他們能克服眾人的偏見勇敢去愛嗎?一場荒謬又有趣的浪漫戀曲即將展開。

programme.title: 抓住你的衣領
programme.desc: 【改編榮獲韓國網路小說懸疑類大獎，熱血記者金荷娜攜手前男友延玗臻聯手調查！】擅長挖掘獨家新聞的女記者徐貞媛，除事業上的成功，與作家丈夫薛宇宰的幸福婚後生活也令人稱羨。某日在犯罪現場成為了目擊者，隨著越演越烈的風波被懷疑為殺人犯，爲證明自己的清白而向刑警前男友泰憲尋求幫助，聯手找尋真相。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉和丈夫恩範已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因恩範外遇出軌導致離婚收場。荷拉時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 人氣封鎖中:UserNotFound
programme.desc: 遇到同音同名也同時作為轉學生的機率，是旼財意想不到的巧合。與作為人氣女王敏在協議交換身份生活，原本逐漸透明的生活開始畫上色彩。隨著時間害怕被拆穿，同時只在敏在面前直率的申義俊，在他的陪伴與守護找到自我。

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 韶華若錦
programme.desc: 【宋威龍x包上恩，甜到掉牙先婚後愛的夫妻生活！！】冷面戰神定北王江緒因調查北軍軍餉貪墨案回到大顯王朝，沒想到貪墨案背後牽連甚廣，為了盡快查明真相，他自願迎娶將門之女明檀，讓明家免遭利用。兩人先婚後愛，相處過程中逐漸產生情愫，並且聯手揭露朝堂陰謀，經歷坎坷後雙向收穫的美好愛情。

programme.desc: A young, vulnerable couple inherits a cork-harvesting farm in rural Catalonia. As newly fledged landowners, they dream of building a fair and sustainable life, only to find their ideals clash head-on with their dire need to make money.

programme.title: Domingo (2021)
programme.desc: After his divorce, 55-year-old Domingo embarks on a belated journey to fulfil his lifelong dream – to become a sports commentator. Though he aspires to join the local TV station, his commentaries are unknowingly leaving an impact on his community.

programme.title: Homicide Unit Istanbul: Thailand (1)
programme.desc: A prisoner transfer to Thailand goes horribly wrong for Detectives Mehmet and Mustafa when the pair are kidnapped by a local crime family and Mehmet is forced to break their boss out of prison to save Mustafa’s life.

programme.title: Behind the Mountains
programme.desc: After spending four years in jail for vandalizing his place of work, Rafik has only one plan, take his son to the mountains and show him his amazing discovery.

programme.title: Playmaker
programme.desc: A former footballer and jailbird, Ivo is no longer interested in football. That is until he meets Lukas, a talented young player, and decides to help him pursue a professional career. But his criminal past soon catches up with him.

programme.title: A Far Shore
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Aoi is an underage mother struggling to make ends meet and dealing with her husband’s violent temper. After her husband loses his job, their continuous fights lead them to a social downfall.

programme.title: Victim
programme.desc: Ukrainian immigrant Irina lives with her son Igor in a small Czech border town. When she discovers that Igor has been assaulted by three Romas her whole world comes crashing down. As times goes on, Irina begins to spot inconsistencies in his story.

programme.title: The Key Witness
programme.desc: BKA bodyguard Jan Schäfer must protect Fiona Weibel, a key witness for the International Tribunal of the Law of the Sea. With Weiber having insider knowledge of a Swiss shipping company's illicit activities, a game of cat and mouse over her life begins.

programme.title: Homicide Unit Istanbul: Thailand (2)
programme.desc: With his colleague’s life on the line, Inspector Mehmet has to bust Thai crime boss Worawit out of jail. But an ambush by the Red Dragon gang leaves Worawit kidnapped and Mehmet injured and semi-conscious. How will Mehmet save his colleague now?

programme.title: Deal At The Border
programme.desc: Aza and Samat, two drug runners navigating the secret routes in the mountains of Central Asia, stumble upon Nazik, a young girl fleeing from slavery. When Nazik is recaptured by a criminal, facing a grim return to captivity, Aza resolves to save her.

programme.title: The Second
programme.desc: An author's success following the release of her celebrated erotic memoir is threatened when her best friend and muse reveals the truth behind the memoir's provenance, igniting an incendiary tale of sex, lies and betrayal.

programme.title: Veins Of The World
programme.desc: After his father dies in a tragic car accident, 11-year-old Amra sets out to continue his father’s vision of the traditional nomad way of life and to continue his fight against global mining companies who threaten to destroy it.

programme.title: Broken Reflections
programme.desc: Tushar, a 17-year-old boy, discovers his mother's extramarital affair on a school bunk which throws him into emotional and psychological turmoil.

programme.title: From The Vine
programme.desc: A burnt-out executive experiences an ethical crisis and travels back to his hometown in rural Italy to recalibrate his moral compass.

programme.title: Clean Sweep 5: Let It Go

programme.desc: The Squirrels build the best rollercoaster anyone ever saw. From a sweet song, to spinning through a helix, and getting the full G-force, it's a ride Duggee's going to remember!

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: Doctor Sing is puzzled by the strange symptoms of his patients and asks his friend for help. The sickness is apparently caused by a black magic that is casted by a wicked man Kong. Kong covets the beauty of Sing's wife and casts an evil love spell on her, while threatening to kill Sing at the same time. Can Sing save his wife and his patients?

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: Dead End
programme.desc: Uninhibited youth Chun meets a rich girl Wen when her car breaks down and drives her home. Chun falls in love with Wen but Wen's brother dislikes him and forbids his sister to see him. He humiliates Chun and gets Chun beaten up, so Chun takes the pistol he has found accidentally on the street to Wen's home and shoots her brother dead.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes.

programme.title: Disco Bumpkins
programme.desc: This musical comedy is about how a young man Fen, along with his buddy Hamburger, finds love and success in the advertising world.

programme.title: The Imperial Swordsman
programme.desc: Fu is a government officer heading home after being charged with falsifying reports. En route, he encounters & recruits a skilled swordsman as a bodyguard. They then meet a fleeing bride and her maid who asked to join them for protection. When the group reach a ruined temple however, a gang of assassins appear and attack them...

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Hui's husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense...

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Shadow Girl
programme.desc: A young swordswoman becomes invisible during the day and a monster at night after taking her grandma's pill. She ruined the wedding of a bandit chief's daughter using her powers and is hunted down by them for revenge. Will she escape the hunt?

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: The Twin Bracelets
programme.desc: Two teenage girls make a pledge to look after each other in a small Chinese fishing town, where the notions of women's rights or sexual freedom are absent. One ends up happily married to a stranger, while the other is cruelly betrothed to the abusive son of a wealthy family and has to seek to free herself from the situation.

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all...

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily found help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques.

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: Boxer Rebellion
programme.desc: The Empress Dowager Cixi believes the Boxers' claim that they have developed a kung fu that makes them impervious to weapons, thus declaring war against the alliances of eight foreign nations. The lack of weapons and good leadership in the Ching government allows the Eight Nation Alliances to take down Beijing.

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: Bloody Parrot
programme.desc: A swordsman is suspected of being the thief of a treasure sent to Emperor. Through his investigation, he is led on to the trail of the supernatural "Bloody Parrot". Poisonous things happen including a demonic possession, witches casting poison spells and disgusting autopsies. Then a dead constable turns into a vampire!

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him...

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again...

programme.title: One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Accepted to the Golden Sword School after his father sacrificed his life to save his master, Fang Kang is resented by his fellow pupils and decides to leave. His master's daughter challenges him to a fight and cuts off his arm. Fang masters the art of sword fighting with one arm and finds himself returning to the School to save his master again.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: How to Pick Girls Up !
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: The Chinese Feast
programme.desc: Sun wants to start a new life as a chef in Canada and struggles to learn cooking skills from a restaurant owner, Au. While Sun will represent his restaurant to participate in a cooking competition, his skill is not good enough, and he has to seek help from a legendary master chef in order to win the ultimate challenge.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Andy is a mahjong master who is very popular in the neighbourhood. However, after being cursed by his ex-girlfriend, Andy always experiences bad luck when playing mahjong. Can he finally dodge this streak of bad luck?

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Wing is an elite in the police force but has been drowning his guilt in booze after his entire team was killed by the "Gang of Five" in a mission. A year later, a young rookie detective with a complicated background is assigned to partner Wing and manages to inspire him into action, as Wing vows to take down the gang.

programme.title: Everlasting Regret
programme.desc: Adapted from an award-winning Chinese novel, the story follows the life of a legendary Shanghai beauty Wang Qi Yao from her glamorous to her simpler days. She stays true to her own way of life while surviving the constant betrayal of her men, and bears witness to the waves of change to her city from 1947 to 1981.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Kung Fu Mahjong 2
programme.desc: Fanny appears to be an ordinary housewife but is in fact a mahjong expert. Deeply in love with her husband, she loses to a seductive woman, Curvy, both on the mahjong table and in competing for her husband's love. With the help from her mahjong master, Fanny vows to take on Curvy in the Mahjong King tournament!

programme.title: Those Were the Days
programme.desc: Director Wong despises Cantonese movies of the 60s, but accidentally travels back in time to that movie set. He meets Director Chu, who tells him he can return to modern time if someone likes the film he makes. Wong meets four classic movie stars and invites them to star in his new film, but it flops unexpectedly. Can Wong return to the present?

programme.title: Ninth Happiness
programme.desc: A comedy starring many popular movie stars, this is a story about a magistrate and his brothers aiming to introduce sin and romance into the virtuous community of Rainbow Village. As they vie for the affections of a charming young village maiden, conflicts arise, adding a twist to their mischievous endeavours.

programme.title: Inner Senses
programme.desc: Haunted by recurring visions stemming from past traumas, Yan reaches out to psychiatrist Dr Jim to restore her sanity and overcome her troubled past. Yet, as Yan gradually heals, Jim finds himself haunted by the same disturbing images, as his suppressed memories resurface.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Dummy Mommy, without a Baby
programme.desc: Fong Lai Kuen works at an advertising agency but is about to be sacked by her boss after offending him. She pretends to be pregnant so that the company cannot fire her, according to the labour law. Since then, Fong receives much care and love from her colleagues and begins to feel guilty about her lie as things develop out of her expectations.

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: Model from Hell
programme.desc: Anna, an exceptional student in a modelling school, becomes the target of envy from fellow models, who all die mysteriously when they want to harm her. It turns out that when Anna is upset, she undergoes a terrifying transformation and can wield lethal psychic power...

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters' best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiance, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended Version)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016.

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsu's funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macau's Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the city's casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: To the Fore
programme.desc: The cycling team's top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find "The Sutra of 42 Chapters". Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Ka Shing meets Kitty one day and they fall quickly in love. However, Kitty disappears shortly and when they meet years later, she is already married. To comfort himself, Ka Shing asks a mystic master to let Kitty appear in his dreams so that he can be with her constantly, even though she can only be his dream lover...

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: The Gambling Ghost
programme.desc: Sammo Hung plays three roles: Fatty, Fatty's father and grandfather. Hoping to become rich, hotel staff Fatty dives into gambling with his friend to the dismay of his father. When Fatty hits rock bottom, his grandfather's ghost appears to help him. As Fatty finds out that his grandfather was murdered, he vows to avenge his death.

programme.title: Long Arm of the Law Part 3
programme.desc: Chinese ex-soldier Li is wrongly accused and seeks refuge in Hong Kong to escape a death sentence. En route, he meets Sam and Moon. While Li has fallen in love with Moon, Hong Kong triad kidnaps Moon and coerces Li into aiding a robbery. Meanwhile, the mainland police officer tracks Li's path to Hong Kong, intensifying the chase.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Wise Guys Never Die
programme.desc: Nick meets Teddy, a con artiste, when he is sent to prison for embezzlement, and Teddy teaches him all the gambling tricks. After their release, they team up with Teddy's lover Lora, to take revenge on Dragon, who framed Teddy for his sentence. Nick though is seduced by Lora and they end up in an affair. Will Nick finally join Teddy in his revenge?

programme.title: Mother VS Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou. Unfortunately, the son of Guan and Zhou falls in love with Li's daughter, and as the two mothers meet, they start brawling again!

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Man's father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes...

programme.title: 97 Aces Go Places
programme.desc: Hao Shi becomes the new triad boss after his father is killed by the pretty swindler, Ling. While professional gunman Drunken Gun is tasked to help Hao Shi take revenge, Ling is hunted by gangster Lei, from whom she has conned 2 million dollars. In the process, Hao Shi and Drunken Gun accidentally arrest Lei instead...

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the school's stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: Shui and Tai are lovers who grew up together in a village but move to the city as Tai's father disapproves of their relationship. Tai secretly works in a nightclub to help finance Shui to get the job of a salesman. When Shui is promoted for his good work and finds himself progressing in his career, he begins to feel distant from Tai...

programme.title: The Story of Woo Viet
programme.desc: Former Vietnamese veteran Woo Viet arrives a refugee camp in Hong Kong and meets his pen pal Quan. Subsequently, he encounters Shum Ching, with whom he attempts to flee to the US. However, the pair end up stranded in Manila's Chinatown, where at the hands of the local triads Woo becomes a hired killer, while Shum is forced into prostitution.

programme.title: The Whole Story with Anderson Cooper - Saving Venice
programme.desc: Erica Hill explores the future of Venice, a city threatened by rising sea levels and the more immediate threat of overwhelming tourism. She speaks with locals working to preserve the city's traditions and address climate change.

programme.title: Amanpour - Bishop Mariann Edgar Budde; Eileen Collins; Andrew Jarecki & Charlotte Kaufman
programme.desc: Christiane speaks with Bishop Mariann Edgar Budde about her recent book "We Can Be Brave" and her own decision to plead directly with President Trump the day after his inauguration to conduct his presidency with mercy for the most vulnerable. Then trailblazing astronaut Eileen Collins sits down with Christiane to discuss her career and how she broke barriers to become NASA's first female space shuttle commander.

programme.title: Intelligent Future - Intellligent Future: Abu Dhabi's Technology Transformation
programme.desc: Emerging technologies are transforming life as we know it. Meet the intelligent minds that are shaping our future. Many of these ideas are already transforming Abu Dhabi into a city of the future. In conversation with Analog's Alex Kipman and teamLab's Takashi Kudo, we explore how the emirate is integrating AI with sports and art for new lived experiences. As quantum research gains momentum, we speak to TII's Leandro Aolita on why it is shaping national strategies for security.

programme.title: Taylor And Travis: The Business Of Love - I Do: The Taylor and Travis Era
programme.desc: The engagement of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce has become an economic engine and a cultural mirror. As they prepare to marry, experts trace the lineage of celebrity romance and its impact on America's hopes, contradictions, and commerce.

programme.title: Intelligent Future - Intellligent Future - Abu Dhabi: City of the Future
programme.desc: The world's smartest cities are built on an audacious blend of creativity, investment and foresight. Becky Anderson explores the innovations driving her home's rise on the global Smart City Index,.

Their goal is to make the school extremely difficult by replacing all the teachers with Teachertron robots. Suffering under the new regime and without Mr. KruppCaptain Underpants on hand to help, the boys hypnotize gym teacher Mr. Meaner and turn him into Sergeant Boxers to fight back.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Frantic Fury of the Fearsome Furculees
programme.desc: Tired of the Melvins ruling the school, the boys realize that they need Mr. Krupp to make the school at least bearable. Unfortunately, Krupp has run off to Ecuador to look for a fabled fountain. So the boys form the M.I.S.F.A.R.T.S. - Mega Incredible Search Force Adventure Rescue Team Squad - to travel to Ecuador and bring Krupp back, whether he wants it or not.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Harmful Horrors of the Harrowing Hiveschool
programme.desc: After injecting all the teachers with bee DNA, the Melvins run the new "hivemind" of the school. But Ms. Ribble is accidently injected with too much "Bee- NA" and becomes the queen bee, overpowering the Melvins' control. George, Harold and the recently re-hired Vice Principal Krupp must work with the Melvins and stop her from turning everyone into her Zombees.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Preposterous Pulverizing of the Pestering Poopacabra
programme.desc: In hopes of raising their grades so they can go to Lake Summer Camp, George and Harold must teach Ratrick, their assigned rat, a simple task. But Ratrick runs away into the sewers where he is doused with toxic waste and transformed into Poopacabra! It's now up to the boys and Captain Underpants to stop the beast before it takes over Piqua with its stench, and more importantly, ruins the boys' chances to go to Lake Summer Camp.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Dastardlys Deed of the Devious Diddlysaurus
programme.desc: George and Harold decide to do an extra credit project on dinosaurs to help their chances of getting summer camp-worthy grades. When Melvin brings in a dinosaur frozen in ice, the boys try to get rid of it. But the ice thaws and they meet Diddlysaurus, a prankster raptor who's huge fans of the boys. He offers to help them with their project if he can pull pranks with them, but when the pranks go too far, the boys and Captain Underpants have to deal with the dino.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Shadowy Syndrome of the Sinister Splotch
programme.desc: Captain Underpants becomes a wanted man in underwear when footage surfaces of a robber who looks exactly like him. George and Harold, positive it's an impostor, try to track down the perp and bring him to justice. But can the boys do this before Captain Underpants is found guilty?

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Bizarre Blitzkrieg of the Bothersome Butt-erflies
programme.desc: As a prank, George and Harold use Melvin's new animal hybrid invention to create a creature that's a cross between a butt and a fly. But some of the monster butt-erflies want to eat everything in sight- including the students hiding out in the school gym!

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Problematic Pandemonium of the Punishing Plungerina
programme.desc: After helping George and Harold make a comic featuring the heroine Plungerina, Erica asserts that Plungerina could be better that Captain Underpants. To prove her wrong, the boys decide to actually create the villain in the comic and then have Captain Underpants save the day. Unfortunately, Krupp - and therefore Captain Underpants - is away at a principals' convention.There's no one to save them...until a real life Plungerina saves tthe day! But who is really Plungerina?

But no one's having any fun! George and Harold want to right this wrong with pranks and comics. But Krupp enlists Mr. Neamer (bizarro Meaner), who then super-enlargers his brain and becomes Brainy Blabulous, in order to stop the subversion of authority.

After offending Caesar with their comic, the emperor is accidentally turned into Cruelius Sneezer and pursues the school group with all his might.

To ensure success, Melvinborg injects Melvin's cells with nanobots, giving him heightened powers. But when George and Harold find out, they crank the nanobots to the max, causing Melvin to grow into a giant! The boys enlist Captain Underpants to fight the jealous nerd, but their victory only loses the nanobots onto Piqua...

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S1 - Captain Underpants and the Taxing Trauma of the Treacherous Tattle Trials Part II

When the humans try to neautralize the bots, they find a new host: Captain Underpants. Now they must shrink down to go into Captain Underpants’ brain and defeat the nanobots’ leader, Nanozero. But they need help: Captain Underpants’ brain cells to the rescue! And when it’s all over, George and Harold will finally be able to go to summer camp.

As they go, Gabby uses the microphone to record sounds from the Gabby Cats’ everyday activities that culminate into a new song that gets DJ his groove back just in time for the show! Having moved to England from Monaco in 2006, Adebayor went on to score 97 Premier League goals in 242 appearances in a career spanning spells at Arsenal, Tottenham Hotspur, Manchester City and Crystal Palace.

programme.title: PL Stories 202526 - EP31
programme.desc: A life-threatening head injury ended Oliver Glasner’s playing career early, but it did nothing to quell his ambition. We go behind-the-scenes to reveal the makings of a manager who has achieved success throughout the past decade in European management, winning European titles in Germany, and the first major silverware in Crystal Palace’s 120-year history.

programme.title: Arsenal vs Aston Villa (MW19) - Premier League 202526
programme.desc: Aston Villa are unbeaten in their last two away league games against Arsenal, beating them 2-0 in April 2024 and drawing 2-2 in January last season. They last had a longer run without defeat the Emirates between 2006-07 and 2008-09 (3).

programme.title: The Big Interview 202526 - EP21
programme.desc: As far as cult hero's go, few are as beloved as Dimitar Berbatov. In a seven-year Premier League career, the Bulgarian set the league alight with his grace and elegance with the ball at his feet. This week, Berbatov sits down with the Big Interview to discuss his upbringing in Blagoevgrad and making a name for himself first with CSKA Sofia and then Bayer Leverkusen.

programme.title: Henry Danger S1 - The Space Rock

programme.desc: Mika and Chapa are determinded to prove to Miles, Bose, and Ray that the new kid in school, Buddy Fudgers, is Lil' Dynomite, before he succesfully completes his plan to get his sworn revenge on his nemesis, Captain Man.

programme.title: iCarly S2 - iSaw Him First

programme.title: iCarly S2 - iStage An Intervention

programme.title: Sam & Cat S1 - #Pilot
programme.desc: Sam and Cat first meet when a wild dilemma lands them in the back of a moving garbage truck. After quickly becoming friends and roommates, they babysit three kids, which give them the idea to start their own babysitting service.

programme.desc: The Ninja Turtles are on the run and...alone. Leonardo is a leader but who is he without anyone to lead? Leo now has to stop Bishop and her Mechazoids while trying to save his brothers.

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants S14 - Snow Yellow

programme.title: Best and Bester S1 - Rock-a-Bye Besty Shake or Break

programme.title: Best and Bester S1 - Tenta-Flakes Boss Level

programme.title: Gods Of Honour - EP34
programme.desc: NAR JAR (CHAN HO MAN, BENNY) was a ‘Fire master’ in his previous life. He was killed by LEE CHING (YUEN WAH). After reincarnation, he ironically becomes CHING’s third son. He is very much affected by his old memories and cannot forgive his father. CHING also keeps his distance from him because of his exotic nature and eventually sends him away with excuses. Luckily, he is saved by some kind people and becomes a General when he is still a teenager.

programme.title: L'Escargot - EP3
programme.desc: Renovation contractor KWAN KA-ON (Miu Kiu Wai) is the elder of four siblings, while his wife SZE LONG-KIU (Sonija Kwok) is a typical housewife. Buying a house is their longtime dream. But when his eldest brother, KWAN KA-HONG’s business goes under, they shelve their plan to help him overcome his difficulties. KIU has to look for a job too.

programme.title: I've Got The Power - EP19
programme.desc: Chung Hau-nin (Ruco Chan), Kiu Yeuk-lam (Natalie Tong) and Ko Yung (Joel Chan) are complete strangers. After surviving a traffic accident, they astonishingly gain mystical power!_x000D__x000D_Hau-nin and Ding Shuk-man (Moon Lau) are a loving young married couple. Hau-nin intends to use his mystical power for his own benefit, but he knows how to use his mystical power to help other people as he is influenced by Yeuk-lam, who has a righteous character.

programme.title: Battle Against Evil, The - EP20
programme.desc: General LI (TONG, MICHAEL) of the Chor Kingdom and wizard CHAI (CHAN HO, MOSES) were colleagues under the same mentor. LI killed CHAR when he found out that CHAR was having an affair with his wife SUKI (LEUNG TSAND, JADE). SUKI was ashamed of her affair, so she committed suicide. After she died, CHAI was furious and killed LI. He used bad magic to turn LI’s spirit into a cloud of hatred in order to prevent him from reincarnation.

programme.title: At The Threshold Of An Era - EP46
programme.desc: The property giant YIP WING TIM (Lo Ka Leung, Gallen) was born in the 60’s in Hong Kong. His father, honest and righteous, was betrayed by his brother and put into prison. TIM, therefore, learned to be wise. He tried all means to take revenge and fortune seeking was always on top of his priorities. With the help from his best friend MA CHI KEUNG (Kwok Chun On), TIM took over an incomplete village housing development.

programme.title: Knot To Treasure - EP13
programme.desc: Wei (Zhu Jiang), the eldest son of Wei (Chen Jiewen), is wild and untamed. Under family pressure, he finally marries Shan (Zhang Fengni), with whom he has been dating for many years. After their marriage, Yat-sen develops an extramarital affair with Yan (Cui Jiabao), eventually living with her and abandoning Shan. Later, realizing Yan's overly open attitude towards relationships, he decides to pursue Shan again.

programme.title: Bottled Passion - EP3
programme.desc: MRS. KO TUNG KWOK-HING (Chan Sau Chu) lies to her husband KO SHIU-TONG (Kwok Fung) that the orphan boy she brings home is his long lost illegal son, KO YEE-HO. TONG believes HO will make a better heir than his elder son, KO YEE-TAI (Chan Shan Chung), resulting in HING’s kicking HO out of the house in anger. HO has been living a vagabond life since. After having enough of the bitter taste of life, he is determined to let the KO family know how it feels to lose one’s family.
